title: MaintainabilityReviewOutput
description: Structured agent output for dk maintainability review. Grades seven flat, non-negotiable maintainability standards from the Thermo-Nuclear Code Quality Review framework. The flat (ungrouped) dimension list and the verdict/severity enums are chosen to project mechanically onto Newton assessment-v1 (scores ×10).

verdict.description: reject: overall<4 or any critical. request_changes: overall 4-5 or any high. approve_with_comments: overall 6-7. approve: overall>=8. Enum is identical to Newton assessment-v1 verdict (passthrough).

overall_score.description: Mean of evaluated dimensions with critical penalty applied (-0.5 per dimension scored <4, floor 0). Projects to Newton overall_score as round(value * 10).

one_paragraph.description: Summary of maintainability health, the single biggest code-judo opportunity (taken or missed), and any critical penalty applied.

grades.description: Per-dimension scores 0-10 with rationale. All seven maintainability dimensions. Projects to Newton scores[] (one entry per evaluated dimension, score ×10).

good_things.description: Structural choices that genuinely improve maintainability and are worth retaining.

limitations.description: What could not be verified (generated code skipped, partial diff, no architectural docs, etc.).

suggested_next_steps.description: Ordered actions for the author, critical findings first.

finding.description: An actionable critique. Carries the mandatory directional triple (observation/why_it_matters/recommended_action) so it projects directly to a Newton observation. Its dimension MUST be an evaluated (scored) dimension, never a not_evaluated one — this preserves Newton's invariant that every observation dimension appears in scores[].

severity.description: critical: score 0-3 (blocks merge, quality penalty). high: score 4-5 (request changes). medium: score 6-7 (approve with comments). low: score 8 (nit-level). Enum is identical to Newton observation severity (passthrough).

location.description: path/to/file.ext:42-48, module name, or change_scope (whole diff). Newton projection parses 'path:range' into a location object {path, range}.

why_it_matters.description: WHY it matters — sharpens the direction.

recommended_action.description: The DIRECTION — what to change. The gradient vector.

evidence.description: Optional short excerpt or symbol reference supporting the observation. Newton projection wraps this into observation.evidence[].

suggested_patch.description: Optional unified diff or code snippet showing the fix.
